newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka 7-mth trade deficit falls to $853 mln.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka 7-mth trade deficit falls to $853 mln.

text.p: Sri Lanka's trade deficit in the first seven months of this year fell to $853 million from $990 million a year earlier, the Central Bank said on Friday.
Exports rose to $2.15 billion in the seven months from $2.08 billion a year earlier, while imports fell to $3.00 billion from $3.07 billion, the bank said.
Industrial exports fell slighly to $1.56 billion in the January-July period from $1.57 billion a year ago, it said.
